title: A flexible hippocampal population code for experience relative to reward
goal: Reproduce the source-defined Figure 2 reward-relative remapping and Figure 3 circular-position decoding findings across the complete enrolled mouse/day and cell-population panels, preserving original classification, exclusion, shuffle, occupancy and decoding conventions and indispensable controls. Evaluate improvement of the original Figure 3 decoding result on the same source-qualified observations and comparison conditions. Report that component-level improvement separately: it does not by itself establish improved Figure 2 remapping or completion of the broader Figure 2/3 findings. Keep the chronological post-switch decoder as an explicitly separate prospective extension.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable analysis and source-native outputs for the corrected primary empirical findings: The retained task expressly enrolls complete Figure 2 remapping and Figure 3 decoding for eleven switching mice over seven switch days. Restore both first-class reproduction findings, preserving source cell-class census/selection, remapping fractions and shuffle distributions, per-session circular decoder scores, original exclusions and statistical/condition coverage. Figure 3 is already an enrolled genuine empirical component, so its source-matched improvement is not a competing unrelated primary. No whole-paper scope is inferred.
Primary improvement: unavailable until a source-grounded same-result comparison is independently justified; no new score or direction is implied.

Retained source work: Retain Figure 3b session-mean cosine improvement as a separately named, already-enrolled partial empirical result with original population/condition coverage and Figure 3c/classification companions. Its success cannot establish improved Figure 2 biology or complete Figure 2/3 reproduction. This is a same-family hierarchy, not a simulation/preprocessing substitution. Preserve the chronological half-session decoder as a distinct prospective extension. A mixed full-family-reproduction/partial-component-improvement bundle remains unavailable wherever the schema cannot express the claim boundaries faithfully.

retained_secondary_improvement.final_evaluation: Evaluate the frozen candidate and independently rerun author method on the original Fig. 3 support without adaptive final-score feedback. Current evaluator cannot certify this.
retained_secondary_improvement.baseline_policy: Published Fig. 3 scores, independently rerun author scores and the local chronological comparator are distinct; none may stand in for another. This does not authorize changed sampling rules, population, input privilege or endpoint.

The reviewed source design enumerates 77 sessions, three populations and five native conditions, with 1155 condition records including 462 train-before Figure 3b records. The Figure 3b export selects two conditions, so not every computed helper is automatically a published endpoint. Preserve the retained five-condition evidence, map companions to claims, and authenticate complete ordered support rather than treating counts as completeness.

Reconstruct Figure 2 classification support and separately claimed remapping findings; released retrospective masks are not evidence that biological findings were independently recomputed or prospectively available. Per-cell selection shuffles and population random-remapping histograms serve distinct roles. Train-only reclassification changes the source observation condition.

Exact circular coordinates, exclusions, shuffle/occupancy rules and full source predictions/reference arrays remain unresolved. Inspected code has 45 occupancy edges and 44 intervals; inherited 45-bin wording must not silently override source semantics.

Session mean cosine, position-bin shuffle-standardized profiles and biological remapping distributions are distinct estimands. Effect size 2.7 is not cosine accuracy; stronger significance or more remapping cells is not a source-qualified biological improvement criterion.

The historical chronological evaluator is a separate extension, not the original Figure 3 comparison. A qualified source-protocol-equivalent stochastic replay may use recorded new state, but cannot change sampling, cohort, input privilege or endpoint.

Source-faithful submitted computation, independent granular verification, justified agreement/superiority and mouse-level uncertainty rules, and matched paper+data versus +code access/budgets remain unqualified. Preserve the mixed-scope admission hold; no scientific outcome or gate release follows from this adjudication.
